comments.body: Which quest gets you to unlock the Suez Canal? Thanks to anyone in advance for answering my question.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: You need to have unlocked panama canal nad have suez and cairo discovered. then head to your nation's palace and get the IQ to unlock suez canal. There are a few IQs to choose from.
